indication_area: Merkel cell carcinoma (metastatic or recurrent locally advanced); squamous cell anal carcinoma
moa: Humanized monoclonal antibody against programmed death receptor-1 (PD-1)

approval_evidence.quote: application_number BLA761334, brand_name ZYNYZ, sponsor INCYTE CORP, submission_type ORIG, submission_status AP, submission_status_date 20230322 (openFDA Drugs@FDA record)

launch_evidence.quote: In March 2023, we announced that the FDA approved ZYNYZ (retifanlimab-dlwr), a humanized monoclonal antibody targeting programmed death receptor-1 (PD-1), under accelerated approval, for the treatment of adults with metastatic or recurrent locally advanced Merkel cell carcinoma (MCC). (Incyte Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2023)

series_start_reason: ZYNYZ was approved 2023-03-22 (2023Q1, taken as the launch quarter); the Q1 2023 release prints no Zynyz revenue row and the first printed quarter is 2023Q2 (570 thousand), one quarter after approval.
search_log: Listed every Incyte (CIK 879169) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions; scanned every 8-K with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2020-07-01 to 2026-11-04 for 'monjuvi|minjuvi|zynyz|niktimvo' in table rows and text (bin/scan.py).

Each release from Q2 2023 prints a 'Zynyz' row in the net product revenues table (unaudited, in thousands); 10-Qs print the same figure as 'ZYNYZ revenues, net' / 'ZYNYZ net sales'. Each quarter taken from its own release, three-months column.

Checks: 2023 570 + 98 + 582 = 1,250; 2024 467 + 651 + 694 + 1,373 = 3,185; 2025 3,009 + 8,921 + 22,674 + 31,747 = 66,351, each equal to the twelve months figure printed in the Q4 release; 2026 six months 41,393 + 49,947 = 91,340 as printed. Prior-year columns match.
